originality.rationale: The most pertinent 2026 paper gives full characteristic classification only for indices at most ten and its index-eleven result is prime-field-only. Its determinant condition leaves 67,89,199 open for extensions; Ayad–Belghaba–Kihel descent does not handle every extension; the coprime-index general classification concerns indices of prime-power-minus-one form. Targeted literature, results-record and accessible history comparisons identified no stronger covering claim. Residual undiscovered implication risk is explicitly recorded.

value.rationale: Index eleven is the first natural parameter directly beyond the source paper’s unrestricted index-at-most-ten classification. The new complete g=11 classification for every finite extension eliminates all three Wendt primes unresolved by the source’s prime-field result, giving a motivated new natural exact invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
